entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings born of the infinite void between realities whose one goal is to consume.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: The whole of reality; all cats in it are said to trace their lineage to Arahbo.

entities.name: Arahbo, the First Fang
entities.description: A legendary cat from whom all cats in the Multiverse are said to descend.

entities.name: Krek
entities.description: A daysquad captain.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: A university where learning about the past means talking to those who were there.

entities.name: Pashin
entities.description: A young squire who aspires to become the greatest skyknight in the kingdom.

entities.name: High Fae
entities.description: Fae to whom spells that take humans years to master come as easily as breathing.

entities.name: Trigori
entities.description: An Azorius senator who learned to triple-check decimals when commissioning homunculi.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: A guild with senators.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker and necromancer who comments on demonic pacts and ruling the dead.

entities.name: Ikko
entities.description: A goblin who accidentally started a riot and enjoyed it.

entities.name: Peren
entities.description: A veteran mercenary.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: A polis protected by four warrior factions, each named for an animal.

entities.name: Koma, World-Eater
entities.description: A monstrous being imprisoned by the gods for fear he would devour the Cosmos.

entities.name: Cosmos
entities.description: The world that the gods feared Koma would devour.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane infiltrated by Planeswalkers, detected by Ral's storm.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The source of the machine gospel that demands surrender to perfection.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: A governing body whose laws confine citizens' freedom.

entities.name: Giada, Font of Hope
entities.description: An angel who is now New Capenna's greatest hope.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A plane whose greatest hope is Giada.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker reflecting that his imagined greatest achievements were only first steps.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: A man so desperate to destroy his brother that he let Gix destroy him.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A being who destroyed Mishra.

entities.name: Admiral Beckett Brass
entities.description: A pirate admiral who prefers living large off gold to squabbling for trinkets.

entities.name: Marsden
entities.description: A party leader whose last words were shouted against Drakuseth.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A planeswalker and fighter who says the will to fight means never being without weapons.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A nature spirit who calls Muldrotha his child.

entities.name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
entities.description: Multani's child, who grew from rot and ruin.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: The Soul of the World, which has returned.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A storm mage whose storm detected Planeswalkers infiltrating Ravnica.

events.summary: Mishra, desperate to destroy his brother, allows Gix to destroy him instead.
events.quote: In Mishra's desperation to destroy his brother, he allowed Gix to destroy him instead.

events.summary: The gods imprison Koma, fearing he would devour the Cosmos.
events.quote: The gods imprisoned Koma, fearing he would eventually devour the Cosmos itself.

events.summary: Ikko accidentally starts a riot and enjoys it.
events.quote: Ikko hadn't intended to start a riot, but now that it was under way, he was having a lot of fun.

events.summary: Marsden shouts his last words to his party before dying.
events.quote: "Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!" —Marsden, party leader, last words

events.summary: The Soul of the World returns.
events.quote: The Soul of the World has returned.

events.summary: Ral's storm detects Planeswalkers infiltrating Ravnica.
events.quote: Ral's storm crackled with mystical detections: Planeswalkers were infiltrating Ravnica.
